title.zh: 绳文：农业之前的定居生活

location.label: Northern Japan; regional reference point near Aomori

summary.en: People in northern Japan sustained settled communities through hunting, fishing and gathering over many millennia. Their settlements, graves, pottery, figurines and stone circles preserve evidence of domestic life and shared rituals. The Jōmon sites show that farming was not the only route to a settled society. This entry represents a broad archaeological tradition across several places, rather than one kingdom or a single unchanging way of life.
summary.zh: 日本北部的人们在漫长岁月中依靠狩猎、捕鱼和采集维持定居社区。聚落、墓葬、陶器、土偶和石圈留下了日常生活与共同仪式的证据。绳文遗址提醒我们，农业并非定居社会的唯一基础。此处呈现的是分布于多个地点、不断变化的考古文化，而不是一个王国。

dateNote.en: Regional span c. 13,000–400 BCE across 17 northern-Japan sites. Individual sites have different dates. The pin is a regional reference near Aomori; nearby Sannai-Maruyama dates to c. 3900–2200 BCE. It does not represent continuous occupation at one place throughout the full regional interval.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前13000—400年是日本北部17处遗址共同呈现的区域时段，各遗址年代不同。地图点位于青森附近，仅作为区域参照；附近的三内丸山遗址约为公元前3900—2200年。整个区域时段不代表同一地点一直有人居住。

sources.title: Jomon Prehistoric Sites in Northern Japan
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis dates the represented sedentary hunter-fisher-gatherer tradition to c. 13,000–400 BCE.

sources.title: Sannai Maruyama Site
sources.publisher: World Heritage Jomon Prehistoric Sites in Northern Japan
sources.evidenceNote: The official component-site page dates the Special Historic Site to c. 3900–2200 BCE and locates it in Aomori City; this differs from the regional span represented by the atlas entry.

title.zh: 哥贝克力石阵：共同建造

summary.en: Communities in Upper Mesopotamia raised large stone enclosures and carved animals onto T-shaped pillars. The site shows that people could organize monumental construction before pottery became part of everyday life here. The buildings are evidence of collective activity; their precise purposes remain a subject of archaeological interpretation.
summary.zh: 上美索不达米亚的居民建起大型石构建筑，并在T形石柱上雕刻动物。这里表明，在当地陶器尚未成为日常用品时，人们已经能组织大型公共建造活动。遗迹留下了共同活动的证据，但建筑的具体用途仍需考古研究来解释。

dateNote.en: Approximate construction range used by UNESCO, not a dated founding event. The pin marks the archaeological site; it is not a cultural boundary.
dateNote.zh: 采用联合国教科文组织所列的大致建造年代，并非精确建城年份。地图标记为考古遗址，不表示文化疆界。

title.zh: 加泰土丘：屋顶上的聚落

summary.en: At Çatalhöyük, closely packed houses were entered from their roofs instead of ordinary streets. Successive building layers preserve paintings, sculpture and household spaces. These remains let archaeologists investigate how people organized long-term settlement, shared space and maintained traditions across generations.
summary.zh: 加泰土丘的房屋彼此紧邻，居民从屋顶进入家中，而非沿普通街道进门。层层叠加的建筑中保存着壁画、雕塑与家庭生活空间。这些遗迹让考古学家能够研究定居者如何安排共同空间，并在一代代人之间延续生活习俗。

dateNote.en: This entry covers the eastern mound's Neolithic occupation, approximately 7400–6200 BCE. The western mound continued later; the end date is not the end of all settlement.
dateNote.zh: 本条目关注东丘约公元前7400至6200年的新石器时代居住阶段。西丘后来仍有人居住，结束年份不代表整个聚落消失。

title.zh: 库克：独立发展的农业

summary.en: At Kuk in the New Guinea highlands, buried traces of mounds and drainage ditches record changing ways of cultivating wetlands. The evidence includes the propagation of crops such as bananas, taro and yams and supports independent agricultural development in this region. Land use has been persistent but episodic rather than unchanged. The long sequence allows learners to compare different agricultural paths and to recognise local knowledge in the management of a difficult environment.
summary.zh: 新几内亚高地的库克遗址中，埋藏的种植土墩和排水沟记录了湿地耕作方式的变化。包括香蕉、芋头和薯蓣等作物的栽培证据，支持这一地区农业独立发展的认识。土地利用长期延续，但也有间歇与变化。它有助于比较不同农业道路，并看见地方知识在环境管理中的作用。

dateNote.en: The rounded start c. 5000 BCE follows the early edge of the 6950–6440 cal BP range for mounded cultivation; BP is anchored to 1950. Land use occurred in phases, including early-20th-century abandonment and renewed settlement around 1960. This focus interval does not imply farming in every year. 2026 is an atlas cutoff, not an end to local traditions.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前5000年的起点取自土墩耕作6950—6440校正距今年范围的较早端，经过取整；BP以1950年为基准。土地利用经历多个阶段，包括20世纪初的离弃与约1960年的重新定居。这一关注时段不表示每一年都在耕作；2026年只是地图截止点，不表示地方传统结束。

sources.title: Kuk Early Agricultural Site
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis describes c. 7,000–6,400-year crop cultivation, later ditch drainage, and episodic land use continuing to the present.

sources.title: Origins of agriculture at Kuk Swamp in the highlands of New Guinea
sources.evidenceNote: The research abstract dates mounded cultivation and intensive banana cultivation to 6950–6440 calibrated years BP. It distinguishes earlier plant exploitation from this stronger evidence of agriculture.

sources.title: Kuk Phase 7, 1969–1990, the Kuk Research Station: A Colonial Interlude
sources.evidenceNote: The scholarly chapter records Kawelka abandonment of Kuk in the early 20th century, absence of inhabitants in 1933, and gradual return from about 1960; a broad focus interval must not imply unbroken occupation or farming.

title.zh: 布吉必姆：贡第杰马拉人的水产系统

location.label: Budj Bim / Tae Rak cultural landscape

summary.en: Gunditjmara communities used the Budj Bim lava landscape to build and maintain channels, weirs and ponds for trapping, holding and harvesting kooyang, or short-finned eel. Dated channels and later walls reveal construction in several phases. Water, stone, seasonal animal movement and community knowledge shaped this system. The landscape remains connected to living Gunditjmara traditions and responsibilities, showing that managed food production includes much more than fields of crops.
summary.zh: 贡第杰马拉人在布吉必姆熔岩地貌上建造、维护水渠、堰坝与池塘，用于捕捉、暂养和收获短鳍鳗。水渠与后加石墙的测年显示，系统经历了多个建设阶段。水流、石材、动物季节性活动与社区知识共同塑造了这一体系。这里仍与贡第杰马拉人的生活传统和责任相连，说明人类管理的食物生产远不止农田种植。

dateNote.en: The approximate start, c. 4650 BCE, refers to an early dated channel at least 6600 calibrated years BP; BP is anchored to 1950, not the current year. It does not date the whole network or the beginning of Gunditjmara culture. Construction and use had several phases. 2026 is an atlas cutoff for living traditions, not a cultural end date.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前4650年的起点依据一段早期水渠至少6600校正距今年的测年；BP以1950年为基准，并非今天。这个日期不代表整个水渠网络同时建成，也不是贡第杰马拉文化的起点。建设与使用经历多个阶段；2026年只是地图截止点，不表示生活传统结束。

sources.title: Budj Bim Cultural Landscape
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis describes at least 6,600 years of constructed aquaculture and continuing Gunditjmara knowledge and practice.

sources.title: Phased redevelopment of an ancient Gunditjmara fish trap over the past 800 years
sources.evidenceNote: The research abstract gives early channel construction at least 6600 cal BP and later basalt block walls around 600–800 cal BP. The atlas uses a rounded civil-year anchor of c. 4650 BCE and treats the network as phased.

sources.title: The detective work behind the Budj Bim eel traps World Heritage bid
sources.evidenceNote: The excavating archaeologist distinguishes an early dated channel from a much later dam wall and describes continuing Gunditjmara relationships with the cultural landscape.

title.zh: 乌鲁克：城市与文字记账

summary.en: By about 3200 BCE, Uruk had become a large city with monumental mud-brick buildings and specialized art. People used signs on clay tablets to record goods and workers' rations. Those administrative experiments helped develop the writing traditions that later became cuneiform, connecting urban growth with new ways to store information.
summary.zh: 到约公元前3200年，乌鲁克已成为拥有大型泥砖建筑与专门艺术生产的城市。人们在泥板上画出符号，记录物品和劳动者的口粮。这些管理活动推动了后来楔形文字传统的发展，使城市成长与保存信息的新方法联系起来。

dateNote.en: An approximate focus on late fourth-millennium urban and recording practices. Uruk continued after this interval; it does not mark the city's complete lifespan.
dateNote.zh: 这里选取公元前第四千纪晚期的城市与记账发展阶段。乌鲁克在此后仍然延续，时间范围并非这座城市的完整寿命。

title.en: Liangzhu: rice, water and an early city
title.zh: 良渚：稻作、水利与早期城市

summary.en: Liangzhu brings together a city, dams and burial grounds in the Yangtze River region. Rice cultivation supported a society that built large earthen works and managed water across its landscape. Differences among burials provide evidence of social hierarchy and shared beliefs. Reading these remains together helps explain how food production, infrastructure and political organisation could develop as connected parts of early urban life.
summary.zh: 良渚将城市、水坝与墓地连成一幅长江流域早期社会的图景。稻作农业支撑着大型土筑工程和跨越周边地区的水利系统。墓葬之间的差异反映社会等级，共同的礼仪器物则帮助人们理解当时的信仰。把这些遗迹放在一起观察，可以看到粮食生产、基础设施与政治组织之间的联系。

dateNote.en: Approximate archaeological date range, 3300–2300 BCE; these are not exact founding and abandonment years.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前3300—2300年为考古年代范围，并非精确的建城与废弃年份。

sources.title: Archaeological Ruins of Liangzhu City
sources.evidenceNote: UNESCO describes c. 3300–2300 BCE, rice cultivation, dams, urban planning and differentiated burials.

title.zh: 卡拉尔：早期安第斯城市

summary.en: Caral's builders organized platform mounds, sunken courts and residential spaces in Peru's Supe Valley. The city belonged to a wider group of settlements, making it a useful place to explore how collective construction and social organization developed in the Andes. Its buildings preserve evidence of an early urban society with ceremonial spaces and a planned arrangement of public and residential areas.
summary.zh: 卡拉尔的建造者在秘鲁苏佩河谷安排了台基、下沉庭院与居住空间。这座城市属于更广泛的聚落群，帮助我们理解安第斯地区的共同建造和社会组织如何发展。建筑保存了早期城市社会的证据，包括仪式空间，以及有规划的公共区域与居住区。

dateNote.en: Approximate 3000–1800 BCE development range from the radiocarbon synthesis on UNESCO's page. Archaeological chronologies vary with the phase and material being dated.
dateNote.zh: 采用联合国教科文组织页面中放射性碳测年综述给出的约公元前3000至1800年范围。不同遗址阶段和测年材料会产生不同的年代判断。

title.en: Dholavira: a city shaped by scarce water
title.zh: 多拉维拉：缺水环境中的城市

summary.en: Dholavira’s inhabitants built an urban settlement on an arid island, using seasonal streams within a planned water-management system. Its fortifications, streets, houses and cemetery show different aspects of social organisation. Workshops and objects made from shell, stone and metal also preserve evidence of skilled production and connections with other regions. The site links the history of cities to a practical question: how can a community organise life around a limited water supply?
summary.zh: 多拉维拉居民在干旱岛屿上建城，把季节性河流纳入水利系统。城防、街道、房屋与墓地呈现社会组织的不同侧面。工坊以及贝壳、石料和金属制品，也留下专业生产与跨地区联系的证据。这处遗址把城市史与一个实际问题联系起来：人们如何围绕有限的水源组织生活？

dateNote.en: Approximate occupation span, 3000–1500 BCE; different urban phases occurred within it.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前3000—1500年为居住年代范围，其中包含不同城市发展阶段。

sources.title: Dholavira: a Harappan City
sources.evidenceNote: Source gives c. 3000–1500 BCE occupation, water systems, workshops, cemetery and interregional trade.

title.zh: 孟菲斯与埃及金字塔建造者

location.label: Memphis and the nearby necropolis, Nile valley

summary.en: Memphis was an administrative and religious centre of Egypt's Old Kingdom. Nearby cemeteries preserve the development from earlier tomb forms to large stone pyramids. Royal monuments, officials' tombs and workshop remains reveal both state organization and changing artistic practices. Much of the surviving evidence comes from burial contexts, so it gives an uneven picture of everyday life.
summary.zh: 孟菲斯是埃及古王国时期的行政与宗教中心。附近墓地保存了早期墓葬向大型石质金字塔发展的证据。王室纪念建筑、官员墓葬和工坊遗迹展现了国家组织与艺术变化。但现存材料多与丧葬有关，不能完整反映普通人的日常生活。

dateNote.en: Approximate Old Kingdom chronology follows the Met's 2649–2130 BCE convention; other chronologies differ. The representative pin marks Memphis, not every pyramid.
dateNote.zh: 年代采用大都会艺术博物馆约公元前2649至2130年的古王国分期，不同研究的年代划分可能不同。标记代表孟菲斯，不是所有金字塔的位置。

sources.title: Egypt in the Old Kingdom (ca. 2649–2130 B.C.)

title.zh: 摩亨佐达罗：规划城市生活

summary.en: Mohenjo-daro’s streets, wells, drains and public bathing structures preserve evidence of an organised urban settlement in the Indus region. Its higher western area and lower town show different arrangements within the city. These remains direct attention to water, sanitation and everyday movement as well as monumental buildings. The surviving archaeological evidence supports questions about civic organisation; it does not by itself identify a named ruler or explain every institution.
summary.zh: 摩亨佐达罗的街道、水井、排水设施和公共浴场留下了印度河流域城市组织的证据。西部高地与下城呈现不同的空间布局。除了大型建筑，这些遗迹也让人关注供水、卫生与日常通行。考古证据可以帮助讨论城市管理，却不能仅凭遗址就确定某位统治者或解释全部制度。

dateNote.en: Approximate urban flourishing, c. 2600–1900 BCE, corroborated by archaeologist Jonathan Mark Kenoyer’s site overview; not exact foundation or abandonment dates.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前2600—1900年的城市繁盛阶段，由考古学家乔纳森·马克·肯诺耶的遗址介绍核实；不是精确建城或废弃年份。

sources.title: Archaeological Ruins at Moenjodaro
sources.evidenceNote: The UNESCO source supports the Indus city context, town planning, drains and wells. Its broad chronology is supplemented by Kenoyer’s site overview.

sources.title: Mohenjo-daro!
sources.evidenceNote: The opened archaeologist-led site overview dates the city’s flourishing to 2600–1900 BCE and documents its streets, wells and drains.

title.en: Yin Xu: bronze work and written questions
title.zh: 殷墟：青铜工艺与甲骨上的问题

summary.en: At the late Shang capital near Anyang, royal buildings, tombs and bronze objects reveal specialised craft production and royal power. Inscriptions on oracle bones record questions connected with divination and preserve evidence of an early Chinese writing system. The intact tomb of Fu Hao adds another view of elite life. The site allows material objects and written evidence to be considered together, while many details of ordinary life remain less visible.
summary.zh: 安阳附近的晚商都城保留了宫殿、墓葬与青铜器，展现专业工艺与王权组织。甲骨上的占卜文字记录了当时人们提出的问题，也是早期汉字的重要证据。保存完整的妇好墓提供了另一种观察贵族生活的角度。遗物与文字能够相互参照，但普通人的许多生活细节仍然难以看见。

dateNote.en: 1300–1046 BCE is UNESCO’s date range for this late Shang capital, not the whole Shang period.
dateNote.zh: 公元前1300—1046年是该晚商都城的年代范围，不代表整个商代。

sources.title: Yin Xu
sources.evidenceNote: Description identifies late Shang capital, 1300–1046 BCE, bronze craftsmanship, Fu Hao tomb and oracle inscriptions.

title.en: Tikal: a Maya city in a forest landscape
title.zh: 蒂卡尔：森林景观中的玛雅城市

summary.en: Tikal brought together temples, palaces, plazas, roads and many residential areas within a Maya urban landscape. Its monumental centre and surrounding settlements reveal the scale of city life in the lowlands. Changes around the ninth century transformed this urban system. Maya peoples continue to sustain communities and living traditions across the region and beyond.
summary.zh: 蒂卡尔的玛雅城市景观包含神庙、宫殿、广场、道路与大量居住区。纪念性中心和周围聚落展现了低地城市生活的规模。九世纪前后的变化改变了这里的城市体系。玛雅人继续在这一地区及更远的地方维系社群与活态传统。

dateNote.en: Approximate sixth-century BCE origins to urban decline around 900 CE, following UNESCO's synthesis. This is a city phase, not a single lifespan for Maya civilization.
dateNote.zh: 依据联合国教科文组织综述，大致从公元前六世纪延伸到公元900年前后的城市衰落。这是城市分期，并非整个玛雅文明的存续范围。

sources.title: Living Maya Time — Teacher Guide
sources.publisher: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian

title.zh: 阿契美尼德帝国：跨地区治理

location.label: Fars, a representative Achaemenid heartland location

summary.en: Cyrus's victories began an imperial expansion that linked parts of western Asia, Egypt and Central Asia. Under Darius, governors and communication routes helped organize the realm. Royal buildings at Susa and Persepolis presented images of peoples bringing tribute. Those images express the court's ideal of authority; they are one kind of evidence, alongside records of conquest and resistance.
summary.zh: 居鲁士的军事胜利开启了帝国扩展，把西亚、埃及与中亚的部分地区联系起来。大流士时期的总督与通信路线帮助组织统治。苏萨和波斯波利斯的王室建筑呈现了各地人民进贡的图像。这些图像表达的是宫廷理想中的权威，需要与征服和反抗的记录一起阅读。

dateNote.en: Conventional 550–330 BCE imperial frame. Territory changed through time. The marker represents the Persian heartland and does not imply a fixed capital or mapped boundary.
dateNote.zh: 采用常见的公元前550至330年帝国分期，疆域在此期间不断变化。标记代表波斯核心地区，不表示固定首都或疆界。

title.zh: 波斯波利斯：王室与多地工艺

summary.en: The Achaemenid rulers built palaces and ceremonial spaces on a large terrace at Persepolis. The architecture combined techniques and artistic traditions from several parts of their empire. Its stairway reliefs and surviving buildings offer a way to study how rulers presented authority and the diversity of the lands they governed.
summary.zh: 阿契美尼德统治者在波斯波利斯的大型台地上修建宫殿与礼仪空间。建筑融合了帝国内多个地区的技术与艺术传统。台阶浮雕及现存建筑帮助我们理解，统治者如何展示权力，并呈现所统治地区的多样性。

dateNote.en: From the conventional foundation date to the destruction of the palace complex in Alexander's campaign. This is the palace's Achaemenid phase, not the whole history of Iran.
dateNote.zh: 采用传统的始建年份与亚历山大征战中宫殿遭破坏的年份，范围限于阿契美尼德王朝阶段，并非伊朗历史的起止。

title.en: Athens: art in the civic landscape
title.zh: 雅典：城邦空间中的艺术

summary.en: In the later fifth century BCE, Athens rebuilt the Acropolis with temples and monumental entrances. The project brought architecture, sculpture, religious practice and civic power together. The surviving buildings give a material starting point for studying classical Athens, while the city's political history needs to be understood beyond the monuments alone.
summary.zh: 公元前五世纪后半叶，雅典在卫城修建神庙与宏大的入口建筑。这项工程把建筑、雕塑、宗教活动与城邦权力结合起来。现存建筑为认识古典雅典提供了具体线索，但理解这座城市的政治生活，还需要超越纪念建筑本身。

dateNote.en: Approximate focus on the second half of the fifth century BCE, not the complete duration of Athenian democracy or Greek civilization.
dateNote.zh: 大致选取公元前五世纪后半叶，不代表雅典民主制度或希腊文明的全部持续时间。

title.zh: 麦罗埃：库施王国的中心

summary.en: Meroë was a royal centre of Kush in the middle Nile region. Pyramids, temples, industrial remains and water reservoirs record a society with its own political and artistic traditions. Trade and production connected this landscape with other African regions and the Mediterranean. The surviving monuments show interaction without making Kush simply an extension of Egypt.
summary.zh: 麦罗埃是尼罗河中游库施王国的王室中心。金字塔、神庙、生产遗迹与蓄水设施记录了当地自身的政治和艺术传统。贸易与生产把这里同非洲其他地区及地中海相连。这些交流痕迹并不意味着库施只是埃及的延伸。

dateNote.en: Approximate focus on Meroë's royal burial and urban phase from the third century BCE to fourth century CE. Kush's earlier history is outside this entry.
dateNote.zh: 本条目大致关注公元前三世纪至公元四世纪麦罗埃的王室墓葬与城市阶段。库施更早的历史不在此时间范围内。

sources.title: Archaeological Sites of the Island of Meroe

title.zh: 秦：建造帝国的地下世界

summary.en: The first Qin emperor’s burial complex combined a large mound, planned enclosures and pits containing terracotta soldiers, horses and other objects. Construction began before the unification of China in 221 BCE. The surviving figures and weapons are evidence of military organisation and specialised production, while the overall layout echoes an imperial capital. A burial monument can therefore be read as evidence about the labour, authority and ambitions of the living.
summary.zh: 秦始皇陵把巨大封土、规划整齐的围墙和兵马俑等陪葬坑组合成地下世界。工程在公元前221年统一之前已经开始。陶俑与兵器反映军事组织和专业化制作，整体布局则呼应帝国都城。观察一座陵墓，也能了解生者社会中的劳动组织、权力和愿望。

dateNote.en: Selected construction window: work began in 246 BCE and continued through the emperor’s death in 210 BCE; this does not assert that every part was completed then.
dateNote.zh: 选取公元前246年开工至公元前210年皇帝去世的施工阶段；不表示所有工程都在这一年完成。

sources.title: Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis gives start in 246 BCE, work through death in 210 BCE, and unification in 221 BCE.

title.zh: 桑吉：营造佛教圣地

summary.en: Sanchi brings together stupas, pillars, temples and monasteries on a hill above the surrounding plain. Much of the surviving monument group dates to the second and first centuries BCE, while the site remained an important Buddhist centre for many later centuries. Its buildings show how a place of worship could accumulate additions over time. The selected interval describes this long religious landscape rather than a single construction campaign.
summary.zh: 桑吉在山丘上汇集了佛塔、石柱、庙宇和寺院。现存古迹中许多可追溯到公元前2—1世纪，此后这里仍长期是佛教中心。建筑群显示，宗教场所可以在一代代人的使用和营造中不断增添内容。这里的时间区间表示长期形成的宗教景观，而不是一次施工工程。

dateNote.en: Broad interval from the 2nd century BCE to the 12th century CE; earlier origins and individual building dates are outside this entry’s scope.
dateNote.zh: 采用公元前2世纪至公元12世纪的宽泛区间；更早起源和单体建筑年代不在本条目范围内。

sources.title: Buddhist Monuments at Sanchi
sources.evidenceNote: Description dates most monuments to 2nd–1st centuries BCE and identifies a major Buddhist centre until the 12th century.

title.zh: 丝绸之路：长安—天山廊道

location.label: Chang’an / present Xi’an; one anchor of a long corridor

summary.en: This corridor linked Chinese capitals with trading settlements and routes reaching Central Asia. It carried more than goods: religious ideas, scientific knowledge, techniques and artistic practices also travelled through its connected communities. The surviving evidence includes cities, cave temples, passes, towers and posthouses. The map marker represents an eastern anchor of a changing network; it should not be read as the origin of every exchange or as a single fixed road.
summary.zh: 这一廊道把中国都城与通向中亚的商贸聚落和道路连接起来。流动的不只是货物，还有信仰、知识、技术和艺术。城市、石窟寺、关隘、烽燧与驿站留下了不同类型的证据。地图上的标记只是不断变化的路网东端之一，不代表所有交流的起点，也不表示丝路是一条固定道路。

dateNote.en: The corridor took shape between the 2nd century BCE and 1st century CE and remained in use into the 16th century. The start is a broad century bound.
dateNote.zh: 廊道于公元前2世纪至公元1世纪间形成，并持续使用至16世纪；起始值为世纪范围的显示边界。

sources.title: Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang’an–Tianshan Corridor
sources.evidenceNote: Description gives formation between 2nd century BCE and 1st CE, use until 16th CE, and multiple forms of exchange.

title.zh: 罗马：城市与帝国治理

summary.en: Rome's imperial history can be explored through public buildings, forums, water systems and monuments. These spaces connected government, religion and everyday urban activity. As imperial authority changed, political centres also shifted. Rome remained a living city after western imperial government ended; its buildings were reused and transformed rather than history stopping at a single date.
summary.zh: 罗马帝国时期的历史可以从公共建筑、广场、供水系统与纪念物中展开。这些空间把治理、宗教和城市日常活动联系起来。随着帝国权力改变，政治中心也发生转移。西部帝国统治结束后，罗马仍有人生活，旧建筑被继续使用与改造，历史并未在某一年停止。

dateNote.en: Conventional western imperial frame, 27 BCE–476 CE. The Eastern Roman Empire continued; this interval must not be treated as the whole Roman world's lifespan.
dateNote.zh: 采用公元前27年至公元476年的常见西部帝国分期。东罗马帝国继续存在，因此不能把这一范围视为整个罗马世界的起止。

title.en: Aksum: connections across the Red Sea
title.zh: 阿克苏姆：跨越红海的联系

summary.en: Aksum stood within trade networks linking northeast Africa, Arabia and the Mediterranean world. Its rulers drew on routes through the port of Adulis, while monumental stone stelae and inscriptions expressed royal authority. Inscriptions in different languages preserve evidence of these connections, and the city's later religious importance outlasted its ancient political power.
summary.zh: 阿克苏姆位于连接非洲东北部、阿拉伯半岛与地中海世界的贸易网络中。统治者依托通往阿杜利斯港的路线，石碑与铭文则展示王权。不同语言的铭文保存了交流的证据，而这座城市后来的宗教地位延续到了古代政权衰落之后。

dateNote.en: Approximate first-to-eighth-century focus following UNESCO's kingdom summary. The city's monuments and religious history span a longer period.
dateNote.zh: 依据联合国教科文组织对王国的概述，大致选取公元一至八世纪。城市建筑与宗教历史的时间跨度更长。

title.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎：大型城市的规划

summary.en: Teotihuacan grew into a large Mesoamerican city organized around a major avenue and monumental complexes. Its builders integrated the valley's landscape into a geometric urban plan, including changes to the river's course. The city's art and architecture influenced other regions, showing that urban influence could travel beyond the people living inside a city.
summary.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎发展为中部美洲的大型城市，以主要大道和大型建筑群组织空间。建造者把河谷地形纳入几何规划，还改变了河流的走向。城市的艺术与建筑影响了其他地区，表明城市影响力能够超越居民实际生活的范围。

dateNote.en: Approximate first-to-seventh-century urban development range used by UNESCO. Earlier occupation and later reuse are outside this focus.
dateNote.zh: 采用联合国教科文组织所列约公元一至七世纪的城市发展阶段，更早的居住与后来的再利用不在本条目重点内。

title.zh: 莫高窟：交汇之地的艺术

summary.en: Mogao’s cave sanctuaries sit near routes used by merchants, pilgrims and travellers. Their wall paintings and sculptures preserve successive layers of Buddhist art and show connections with artistic traditions elsewhere in Asia. The caves were made and renewed across many generations, rather than as one project. Comparing their images turns a map of trade routes into a question about how beliefs, techniques and visual ideas moved between communities.
summary.zh: 莫高窟靠近商人、朝圣者和旅行者往来的道路。壁画与雕塑保留了不同阶段的佛教艺术，也呈现与亚洲其他地区艺术传统的联系。这些洞窟经过许多代人的建造与修缮，并非一次完成。比较其中的图像，可以进一步思考信仰、技艺与视觉表达如何随人员往来而传播。

dateNote.en: Broad century interval: 4th–14th centuries CE. The interval describes the artistic sequence, not exact opening and closing dates.
dateNote.zh: 采用公元4—14世纪的宽泛区间，表示艺术发展的阶段，而非精确的开创与终止年份。

sources.title: Mogao Caves
sources.evidenceNote: UNESCO identifies the Silk Route crossroads and approximately one millennium of Buddhist art.

sources.title: Mogao Grottoes, Dunhuang: exhibition note
sources.publisher: Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts
sources.evidenceNote: Page 1 dates the cave art broadly to the 4th–14th centuries and describes Asian artistic connections.

title.en: Eastern Roman Empire: continuity and change
title.zh: 东罗马帝国：延续与变化

summary.en: The empire centred on Constantinople continued Roman political traditions while its language, institutions, territories and religious culture changed. Art and architecture connected courts, churches and urban communities. The conquest of Constantinople in 1204 fragmented imperial authority; rulers based elsewhere sustained successor states before the city's recovery in 1261. The history therefore contains interruptions within its long conventional date range.
summary.zh: 以君士坦丁堡为中心的帝国延续了罗马政治传统，同时语言、制度、领土与宗教文化不断改变。艺术和建筑连接着宫廷、教会与城市社群。1204年君士坦丁堡被攻占，帝国权威分裂；其他地方的统治者维持继承政权，直到1261年收复城市。因此，漫长分期之中也包含中断。

dateNote.en: Conventional 330–1453 frame. Constantinople was under Latin rule in 1204–1261; successor states and regional continuities make this more complex than one uninterrupted polity.
dateNote.zh: 采用330至1453年的常见分期。1204至1261年君士坦丁堡受拉丁政权控制，继承国家与地区延续使历史比单一政权的连续存续更复杂。

title.en: Nalanda: learning in a monastic community
title.zh: 那烂陀：寺院社区中的学习

summary.en: Nalanda combined places for study, residence and religious practice. Its surviving monasteries, shrines, stupas and artworks record a long association between the transmission of knowledge and Buddhist institutions. The main scholastic establishment developed from the fifth century CE and continued into the thirteenth. The site helps distinguish the history of an institution from the history of its buildings: archaeological remains can predate the educational phase highlighted here.
summary.zh: 那烂陀把学习、居住与宗教实践的场所结合在一起。寺院、祠堂、佛塔和艺术品记录了知识传授与佛教机构之间的长期联系。这里重点呈现公元5—13世纪的教学机构。考古遗迹有些早于这一阶段，因此应区分一个机构的历史与整片遗址的历史。

dateNote.en: 5th–13th centuries CE covers the scholastic phase in UNESCO’s synthesis; the site also contains earlier remains.
dateNote.zh: 公元5—13世纪对应来源综述中的教学机构阶段；遗址另有更早遗存。

sources.title: Archaeological Site of Nalanda Mahavihara at Nalanda, Bihar
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis distinguishes c. 3rd-century BCE remains from the 5th–13th-century monastic-scholastic establishment.

title.en: Gyeongju: Buddhist art in a royal landscape
title.zh: 庆州：王都景观中的佛教艺术

summary.en: Gyeongju preserves temples, palaces, pagodas, reliefs and sculptures associated with the Silla capital. The concentration of Buddhist art shows how religious expression became part of an urban and royal landscape. Looking across several sites reveals different forms of patronage and craftsmanship rather than one isolated monument. This selected period focuses on the seventh to tenth centuries, when the surviving artistic tradition represented here was particularly active.
summary.zh: 庆州保留了与新罗都城有关的寺庙、宫殿、佛塔、浮雕和造像。集中的佛教艺术展示了宗教表达如何成为城市与王都景观的一部分。把多个遗址联系起来，可以观察不同形式的营造和工艺，而不只关注一座孤立的古迹。这里选取7—10世纪的艺术发展阶段。

dateNote.en: 7th–10th centuries CE is the source’s artistic focus; it is not the complete chronology of Silla or of Korean Buddhism.
dateNote.zh: 公元7—10世纪是来源强调的艺术阶段，并非新罗或朝鲜半岛佛教的完整年代。

sources.title: Gyeongju Historic Areas
sources.evidenceNote: Description emphasises Buddhist art from the 7th–10th centuries; synthesis identifies the Silla capital landscape.

title.en: Borobudur: a monument to move through
title.zh: 婆罗浮屠：在行进中阅读的建筑

summary.en: Borobudur’s builders arranged square terraces, circular platforms and a large upper stupa into a Buddhist monument in central Java. Reliefs and Buddha images give its architectural levels a visual language as well as a physical form. The eighth and ninth centuries frame its construction here. The monument encourages a comparison between looking at a building from outside and learning through movement, sequence and repeated images within its spaces.
summary.zh: 婆罗浮屠的建造者把方形台层、圆形平台和顶部大塔组合成爪哇中部的佛教建筑。浮雕与佛像使不同层次既有空间形式，也有视觉语言。这里以公元8—9世纪表示其营造阶段。它引出一个观察角度：从外部观看建筑，与在空间中通过行进、顺序和反复出现的图像来理解建筑，有何不同？

dateNote.en: Broad construction centuries, 8th–9th CE; not exact foundation/completion years or an end date for Buddhist practice.
dateNote.zh: 采用公元8—9世纪的营造范围；不是精确开工与竣工年份，也不是佛教实践的终止时间。

sources.title: Borobudur Temple Compounds
sources.evidenceNote: Source dates the temple to the 8th–9th centuries and describes terraces, circular platforms, reliefs and stupas.

title.zh: 卡霍基亚：原住民的城市景观

summary.en: Cahokia was a large Indigenous settlement with earthen mounds, surrounding villages and agricultural communities. Monks Mound and the wider layout show the scale of organized construction in the Mississippi valley. The settlement offers evidence of the cultural, religious and economic life of Mississippian societies and the relationships between a large centre and its surrounding communities.
summary.zh: 卡霍基亚是一处大型原住民聚落，拥有土丘、周围村庄与农业社群。僧侣丘及整体布局展示了密西西比河谷组织建造的规模。这处聚落为认识密西西比文化社群的文化、宗教和经济生活，以及大型中心与周围社群的关系，提供了证据。

dateNote.en: Approximate main occupation range, 800–1400, from UNESCO. The page places the city's population peak around 1050–1150, within this longer span.
dateNote.zh: 联合国教科文组织所列主要居住时期约为800至1400年，其中城市人口高峰约在1050至1150年。

title.zh: 吴哥：都城群的景观

summary.en: Angkor contains remains of several Khmer capitals, including Angkor Wat and the Bayon at Angkor Thom. Temples and other urban remains spread across a large landscape rather than forming a single isolated monument. The ninth to fifteenth centuries provide the historical frame used here. The site offers a way to explore how religious buildings and political centres were related, while remembering that Khmer history and communities extend beyond this selected capital period.
summary.zh: 吴哥包含多个高棉都城的遗迹，其中有吴哥寺，以及吴哥城内的巴戎寺。寺庙和其他城市遗存分布在广阔景观中，并非一座孤立古迹。本条目采用公元9—15世纪的时间框架，帮助观察宗教建筑与政治中心之间的关系。高棉的历史与社区当然不限于这一都城阶段。

dateNote.en: 9th–15th centuries CE is a broad capital-site interval from UNESCO, not a precise start/end of Khmer culture.
dateNote.zh: 公元9—15世纪是来源对都城遗址的宽泛区间，不是高棉文化的精确起止年代。

sources.title: Angkor
sources.evidenceNote: Description identifies different Khmer capitals from the 9th–15th centuries and names Angkor Wat and Bayon.

title.zh: 萨迈拉：阿拔斯都城的规划

summary.en: Samarra served as an Abbasid capital on the Tigris. Its palace complexes, mosques and planned spaces preserve evidence of ninth-century urban ambitions. Decorative stucco and ceramic production linked the city to wider artistic exchange. The archaeological remains reveal a capital's layout without representing every community governed by the caliphate.
summary.zh: 萨迈拉曾是底格里斯河畔的阿拔斯王朝都城。宫殿、清真寺与规划空间留下了九世纪城市建设的证据。灰泥装饰和陶瓷制作也把这座城市与更广泛的艺术交流联系起来。遗址呈现都城布局，并不代表哈里发统治下所有地区的生活。

dateNote.en: 836–892 is the capital phase documented by UNESCO. Occupation continued in parts of the area after the court left.
dateNote.zh: 836至892年是联合国教科文组织记载的都城阶段。宫廷迁走后，部分地区仍有人居住。

title.en: Chaco: a regional centre and its connections
title.zh: 查科：区域中心及其联系

summary.en: Ancestral Pueblo communities made Chaco a centre for ceremony, exchange and political activity. Large masonry buildings and roads to outlying settlements reveal organization across a region. As Chaco's role changed, people moved and other centres developed. Pueblo peoples maintain connections with this landscape, including its place in sacred migration histories.
summary.zh: 普韦布洛人的祖先使查科成为仪式、交流与政治活动的中心。大型石砌建筑以及连接外围聚落的道路，呈现了区域性的组织。随着查科的地位改变，人们迁移，其他中心逐渐发展。普韦布洛人与这片景观仍保持联系，其中包括神圣迁徙历史中的记忆。

dateNote.en: 850–1250 is UNESCO's selected period for Chaco as a regional centre. It is not the beginning or end of Pueblo peoples.
dateNote.zh: 850至1250年是联合国教科文组织给出的查科区域中心阶段，并非普韦布洛人的历史起点或终点。

title.en: Quanzhou: a port and its hinterland
title.zh: 泉州：港口与腹地

summary.en: Quanzhou’s maritime trade depended on a connected system of docks, bridges, workshops, transport routes and administrative buildings. Religious sites, including a mosque, also preserve evidence of the people who met in this trading city. During the Song and Yuan periods, the port linked production in its hinterland with wider maritime exchange. Exploring these places together shows why the history of a port extends far beyond the edge of the sea.
summary.zh: 泉州的海上贸易依靠码头、桥梁、工坊、交通线路与管理设施组成的系统。包括清真寺在内的宗教遗迹，也记录了来到这座商贸城市的人群。宋元时期，港口把腹地生产与更广泛的海上交流联系起来。把这些地点一起观察，会发现港口的历史远不止海岸边的船只。

dateNote.en: Selected maritime trading phase: 10th–14th centuries CE. The end does not imply that Quanzhou ceased to exist or trade.
dateNote.zh: 选取公元10—14世纪的海贸阶段；结束年份不表示泉州此后不再存在或贸易。

sources.title: Quanzhou: Emporium of the World in Song-Yuan China
sources.evidenceNote: UNESCO’s stated Song-Yuan maritime phase is 10th–14th centuries; includes docks, production and religious sites.

title.zh: 威尼斯：泻湖中的城市

summary.en: Venice developed on a group of lagoon islands and became a maritime power. Its urban form reflects the need to build, move and trade within a watery landscape. Buildings and works of art preserve connections across the Mediterranean. Studying Venice also means looking at the dependence between a city, its trading networks and the environment around it.
summary.zh: 威尼斯在泻湖岛屿之间发展，并成为海上力量。城市形态反映了人们在水域环境中建设、交通和贸易的需要。建筑与艺术品保留着跨地中海联系的痕迹。认识威尼斯，也是在理解城市、贸易网络与周围环境之间的相互依赖。

dateNote.en: Editorial focus on the tenth through sixteenth centuries of maritime and cultural development. These dates do not define the republic's complete political lifespan.
dateNote.zh: 本条目选取十至十六世纪的海上与文化发展阶段，并非威尼斯共和国完整的政治存续年代。

title.zh: 科尔多瓦：哈里发都城

summary.en: Córdoba was a major urban centre of al-Andalus. Its Great Mosque and surrounding historic fabric preserve layers of Roman, Islamic and later Christian building. During the caliphate, the city represented concentrated political and cultural resources. Its later changes show that buildings can survive by taking on new uses, while their meanings remain contested.
summary.zh: 科尔多瓦曾是安达卢斯的重要城市。大清真寺与周围历史街区保存了罗马、伊斯兰和后来基督教建筑的不同层次。在哈里发时期，城市汇聚了政治与文化资源。后来的改变也说明，建筑可因用途变化而延续，其意义却可能不断受到讨论。

dateNote.en: 929–1031 denotes the Caliphate of Córdoba, as listed by UNESCO. The city and mosque predate this period and continued afterward.
dateNote.zh: 929至1031年指联合国教科文组织列出的科尔多瓦哈里发时期。城市与清真寺在此之前已存在，此后也继续延续。

title.zh: 蒲甘：信仰塑造的景观

summary.en: Bagan’s temples, stupas, monasteries, paintings and sculptures spread across the plain beside the Ayeyarwady River. They preserve evidence of a period when the city was the capital of a regional empire and Buddhist patronage supported extensive building. The selected eleventh to thirteenth centuries describe the historical concentration represented by these monuments. The landscape also remains a place of pilgrimage, so an archaeological date range should not imply that its religious life simply ended.
summary.zh: 蒲甘的寺庙、佛塔、寺院、壁画与雕塑分布在伊洛瓦底江畔的平原上。它们记录了这里作为区域帝国都城、佛教供养推动广泛营造的阶段。本条目选取公元11—13世纪，表示古迹所集中呈现的时期。这里仍是朝圣景观，考古年代的结束不能被理解为宗教生活随之终止。

dateNote.en: 11th–13th centuries CE follows UNESCO’s current English description; other language summaries on the same page are inconsistent.
dateNote.zh: 采用来源当前英文描述的公元11—13世纪；同页部分其他语言摘要的世纪范围不一致。

sources.title: Bagan
sources.evidenceNote: English description identifies a peak in the 11th–13th centuries and lists temples, monasteries, art and pilgrimage places.

title.en: Great Zimbabwe: stone building and trade
title.zh: 大津巴布韦：石筑城市与贸易

summary.en: Shona communities built Great Zimbabwe's stone enclosures and settlements. The city connected farming and local production with long-distance trade. Imported beads, ceramics and coins provide evidence of links beyond southern Africa. Its architecture and archaeology preserve a history of African urban organization and connections across the Indian Ocean.
summary.zh: 绍纳人的社群建造了大津巴布韦的石墙与聚落。城市把农业、当地生产和长途贸易联系起来。外来的珠饰、陶瓷与钱币留下了跨地区联系的证据。这里的建筑与考古发现，保存了非洲城市组织和跨印度洋交流的历史。

dateNote.en: Approximate construction span of 1100–1450 used in UNESCO's archaeological synthesis. This is a site's phase, not the lifespan of Shona peoples.
dateNote.zh: 采用联合国教科文组织考古综述中的约1100至1450年建造阶段。这是遗址的发展时期，并非绍纳人的历史起止。

title.en: Nan Madol: building with sea and stone
title.zh: 南马都尔：海水与石材中的营造

summary.en: Nan Madol consists of artificial islets edged with basalt and coral stone near Pohnpei. Palaces, temples, tombs and residences formed a ceremonial centre associated with the Saudeleur dynasty. The surviving scale and arrangement of the buildings preserve evidence of organised work and social distinctions in a Pacific island society. The marker shows the centre’s location; it does not turn the surrounding ocean or islands into a precisely mapped political territory.
summary.zh: 南马都尔位于波纳佩岛附近，由玄武岩和珊瑚石围筑的人工小岛组成。宫殿、庙宇、墓葬与居住区共同构成与绍德雷尔王朝有关的仪式中心。遗存的规模与布局，记录了太平洋岛屿社会的劳动组织和社会差异。标记表示中心位置，并不意味着能据此精确绘出其海域或政治疆界。

dateNote.en: 1200–1500 CE follows the source’s broad building phase; political and settlement transitions were not necessarily simultaneous.
dateNote.zh: 公元1200—1500年采用来源给出的宽泛营造阶段；政治和聚落变迁未必同时发生。

sources.title: Nan Madol: Ceremonial Centre of Eastern Micronesia
sources.evidenceNote: Description dates stone palaces, temples, tombs and residences to 1200–1500 CE and associates the site with Saudeleur ceremonial authority.

title.en: Rapa Nui: a monumental island landscape
title.zh: 拉帕努伊：岛屿上的纪念性景观

location.label: Rapa Nui; representative point near Rano Raraku

summary.en: Rapa Nui communities created stone moai and ceremonial places that transformed the island landscape. These works offer evidence about sculpture, architecture and collective effort in a Polynesian society. This entry selects a later portion of the monument-building period and does not fix the disputed date of first settlement. It also avoids treating the monuments as evidence that the island’s people or living culture disappeared when a construction phase changed.
summary.zh: 拉帕努伊人建造莫阿伊石像与仪式场所，改变了岛屿景观。这些作品记录了波利尼西亚社会的雕塑、建筑和集体劳动。本条目选取纪念性建筑阶段中的较晚部分，不以此确定仍有研究争论的首次定居年代，也不把营造活动的变化理解为当地居民或活态文化的消失。

dateNote.en: 1200–1600 is an editorial focus within UNESCO’s broader monument period; no claim is made that settlement began in 1200 or that culture ended in 1600.
dateNote.zh: 1200—1600年是来源较宽泛营造时期内选取的学习窗口；不表示1200年才定居或1600年文化结束。

sources.title: Rapa Nui National Park
sources.evidenceNote: Source supports monumental sculpture and shrine construction into the 16th century. Its older c. 300 CE settlement statement is excluded as disputed/outdated.

title.en: Kilwa: an Indian Ocean trading city
title.zh: 基尔瓦：印度洋贸易城市

summary.en: Merchants at Kilwa connected the East African coast with routes across the Indian Ocean. Gold and other goods circulated alongside ceramics from Arabia, Persia and China. The ruins of mosques, palaces and houses show a coastal urban society shaped by both local activity and overseas exchange.
summary.zh: 基尔瓦商人把东非海岸与跨越印度洋的路线相连。黄金等物品流通的同时，阿拉伯、波斯和中国的陶瓷也来到这里。清真寺、宫殿与住宅遗迹展现出一个由本地活动和海外交流共同塑造的海岸城市社会。

dateNote.en: Focus on the thirteenth-to-sixteenth-century trading phase described by UNESCO. The city's history extends beyond the selected interval.
dateNote.zh: 本条目关注联合国教科文组织描述的十三至十六世纪贸易阶段，城市历史并不限于这一时段。

sources.title: Ruins of Kilwa Kisiwani and Ruins of Songo Mnara

title.en: Mali Empire: power, exchange and historical evidence
title.zh: 马里帝国：权力、交流与历史证据

location.label: Mande heartland: a representative point, not an identified capital

summary.en: Mali grew from a kingdom in the Mande region into a state with connections across West Africa and distant trade networks. Historians reconstruct its past using oral traditions, Arabic chronicles, European accounts and archaeology. These sources answer different questions and do not always agree. Even the location and character of its capitals remain subjects of research.
summary.zh: 马里从曼德地区的王国发展为一个联系西非多地与远方贸易网络的国家。历史学家结合口述传统、阿拉伯文献、欧洲记录和考古材料重建其过去。不同来源回答的问题并不相同，也未必彼此一致；其都城的位置与性质至今仍是研究课题。

dateNote.en: Broad thirteenth-to-sixteenth-century focus follows the cited research abstract; endpoints are century bins, not exact founding and dissolution years. The marker is a regional reference, not a claimed capital.
dateNote.zh: 依据所引研究摘要，大致选取十三至十六世纪；端点是世纪分段，不是精确的建国或解体年份。标记是区域参照点，不代表已确定的首都。

sources.title: The Empire of Mali — research abstract

title.zh: 蒙古帝国：扩展与分裂

summary.en: The unification under Chinggis Khan in 1206 preceded conquests across Eurasia. Campaigns caused destruction as imperial rulers built systems for military coordination, taxation and resource sharing. Succession conflicts brought political fragmentation in the 1260s. Networks between ruling houses and regions continued afterward, so political division did not end all connections.
summary.zh: 1206年成吉思汗统一蒙古各部，随后展开跨越欧亚大陆的征战。战争造成破坏，帝国统治者同时建立军事协作、税收和资源分配制度。1260年代的继承权冲突带来政治分裂，但统治家族与地区之间的网络此后仍然延续，政治分裂并不意味着所有联系中断。

dateNote.en: 1206–1260 is a teaching frame for the unified imperial phase. Fragmentation unfolded through the 1260s; successor khanates continued beyond it. The pin represents the Mongolian plateau.
dateNote.zh: 1206至1260年用作统一帝国阶段的教学分期。分裂贯穿1260年代，继承汗国此后继续存在。标记代表蒙古高原。

sources.title: The Mongol Empire: Fragmentation, Unity, and Continuity (1206–c.1300) — abstract
The Mongol Conquests: Three Invasions Led by Chinggis

title.en: Ottoman Empire: cities and imperial networks
title.zh: 奥斯曼帝国：城市与帝国网络

summary.en: Ottoman rule connected cities and communities across parts of Europe, western Asia and North Africa. In the early modern period, Istanbul, Cairo, Aleppo and Bursa were linked by commerce, administration and artistic patronage. Workshops and court institutions spread designs while regional production continued. The empire's extent and internal relationships changed over its long history.
summary.zh: 奥斯曼统治连接了欧洲、西亚与北非部分地区的城市和社群。近代早期，伊斯坦布尔、开罗、阿勒颇与布尔萨通过商业、治理和艺术赞助相互联系。工坊与宫廷机构传播设计，各地生产也持续发展。帝国疆域和内部关系在漫长历史中不断变化。

dateNote.en: Approximate conventional start around 1299; 1922 marks the empire's end in the cited chronology. Istanbul is a later capital, not the seat of government throughout the full interval.
dateNote.zh: 起点采用约1299年的常见分期，1922年是所引来源的帝国结束年份。伊斯坦布尔是后期首都，并非整个时段的统治中心。

title.zh: 亨比：市场、寺庙与水利

summary.en: Hampi preserves parts of the Vijayanagara capital along the Tungabhadra River. Temples, bazaars, royal buildings, streets and waterworks formed connected urban systems within a rocky landscape. The surviving remains show both ceremonial life and the infrastructure that supported the city. Its conquest and sack in 1565 mark a major disruption to the capital, but should not be mistaken for the end of all communities or traditions associated with this region.
summary.zh: 亨比沿通加巴德拉河保留了毗奢耶那伽罗都城的遗迹。寺庙、集市、宫廷建筑、街道与水利设施在岩丘景观中彼此连接，既呈现仪式生活，也显示支撑城市的基础设施。1565年的征服和劫掠是都城历史的重要断裂，但不能因此认为该地区的所有社区与传统都随之结束。

dateNote.en: Start is the broad 14th-century bound; 1565 marks the documented sack of the capital, not the end of the entire Vijayanagara state.
dateNote.zh: 起始值为14世纪的范围边界；1565年表示都城被劫掠，不代表整个毗奢耶那伽罗国家终结。

sources.title: Group of Monuments at Hampi
sources.evidenceNote: Source describes the 14th–16th-century capital, the 1565 sack, bazaars, temples, residential areas and hydraulic features.

title.zh: 撒马尔罕：交流与求知的交汇处

summary.en: Samarkand developed across many centuries of Central Asian exchange. In the Timurid period, rulers and patrons sponsored monumental buildings, religious schools and Ulugh Beg's observatory. The city shows how political power, craft and the study of the sky could meet in one urban setting.
summary.zh: 撒马尔罕经历了多个世纪的中亚交流。在贴木尔王朝时期，统治者与赞助者推动了大型建筑、宗教学校及兀鲁伯天文台的建设。这座城市让人看到，政治权力、工艺与天文研究如何在同一城市中汇聚。

dateNote.en: An editorial focus on the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries identified by UNESCO. Samarkand's settlement history began much earlier and continues today.
dateNote.zh: 本条目选取联合国教科文组织强调的十四至十五世纪。撒马尔罕的聚落历史早得多，今天仍是一座城市。

title.zh: 塔普塔普阿泰：跨越海洋的联系

summary.en: Taputapuātea’s marae combined political, ceremonial and funerary roles on Ra’iātea. They linked relationships among living communities with relationships to ancestors and gods. Stones taken to other islands helped establish related marae, providing material evidence of connections across the ocean. The selected fourteenth to eighteenth centuries describe a building tradition, while the place also belongs to an enduring cultural landscape. Ocean distance should not be confused with a lack of social connection.
summary.zh: 赖阿特阿岛上的塔普塔普阿泰祭祀场兼具政治、仪式和丧葬功能，把社区之间的关系与祖先、神灵联系起来。石材曾被带往其他岛屿建立相关祭祀场，留下跨海联系的物质证据。本条目选取14—18世纪的营造传统，而这一地点仍属于延续中的文化景观。海洋距离并不等于社会隔绝。

dateNote.en: 14th–18th centuries CE follows the source’s marae-building interval, not the lifespan of Mā’ohi civilisation.
dateNote.zh: 公元14—18世纪对应来源中的祭祀场营造阶段，并非毛希文明的全部存续年代。

sources.title: Taputapuātea
sources.evidenceNote: Criterion (iv) describes marae from 14th–18th centuries and stones transported to found related marae on other islands.

title.zh: 佛罗伦萨：文艺复兴艺术的制作

summary.en: Florence's fifteenth- and sixteenth-century development linked economic resources, patronage and artistic production. Churches, palaces and public spaces became settings for new architectural and artistic work. Its surviving urban fabric helps show that the Renaissance was made through workshops, commissions and buildings over time, rather than appearing as a single invention.
summary.zh: 十五至十六世纪的佛罗伦萨，把经济资源、赞助制度与艺术生产联系起来。教堂、宫殿和公共空间成为建筑与艺术创作的场所。保存至今的城市空间让人看到，文艺复兴通过工坊、委托与长期建设逐步形成，而不是一次突然出现的发明。

dateNote.en: Selected fifteenth-to-sixteenth-century focus from UNESCO's description. Florence's settlement and artistic history extends far beyond this interval.
dateNote.zh: 依据联合国教科文组织的描述，选取十五至十六世纪作为重点。佛罗伦萨的聚落与艺术历史远不止这一阶段。

title.en: Melaka: a meeting place in the straits
title.zh: 马六甲：海峡中的交汇之城

location.label: Historic Melaka; George Town is a separate related component

summary.en: Melaka’s buildings and townscape reflect a long history of trade and cultural exchange through the straits. Its early urban story includes the Malay sultanate and later Portuguese and Dutch rule. The related heritage property also includes George Town, whose buildings represent a different, later phase. This marker focuses on Melaka and treats colonial control, commerce and cultural encounter as connected subjects without reducing them to a simple story of harmonious exchange.
summary.zh: 马六甲的建筑与城市景观呈现了海峡贸易和文化往来的长期历史，其中包括马来苏丹国以及后来的葡萄牙、荷兰统治。相关遗产还包括乔治市，但它反映另一较晚阶段。本标记聚焦马六甲，把殖民控制、商业和文化接触联系起来，而不将复杂历史简化为始终和谐的交流。

dateNote.en: Selected 15th–19th-century learning window; 1900 is an editorial endpoint, not the end of the city, trade or its communities.
dateNote.zh: 选取15—19世纪作为学习窗口；1900年是编辑设定的结束点，不代表城市、贸易或社区的终结。

sources.title: Melaka and George Town, Historic Cities of the Straits of Malacca
sources.evidenceNote: Source describes 500 years of exchange, the 15th-century sultanate, Portuguese/Dutch phases and later George Town.

title.zh: 印加路网：连接安第斯

location.label: Cusco, a representative hub of the Andean road network

summary.en: The Inca road network connected mountain, coastal and valley landscapes. It supported communication, movement, storage and administration, and incorporated earlier infrastructure. The network reached its greatest extent in the fifteenth century. A point at Cusco represents one hub; the roads and the communities using them extended across a much larger region.
summary.zh: 印加道路网连接山地、海岸与河谷，支撑通信、出行、储存和治理，并吸纳了更早的基础设施。路网在十五世纪达到最大规模。地图上库斯科的标记只代表其中一个枢纽，道路以及使用它们的社群分布在远更广大的地区。

dateNote.en: Selected fifteenth-century expansion phase from UNESCO. Roads existed earlier and many routes remained in use later; the pin is not the whole network.
dateNote.zh: 选取联合国教科文组织记载的十五世纪扩展阶段。部分道路更早就已存在，后来许多路线仍被使用；单个标记不等于完整路网。

title.zh: 廷巴克图：学术之城

summary.en: Timbuktu became a centre of Islamic scholarship and teaching in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. Its mosques and madrasas supported intellectual and religious life near a meeting point of Saharan and river routes. The city helps place education and the circulation of ideas alongside the trade and state histories of West Africa.
summary.zh: 十五至十六世纪的廷巴克图是伊斯兰学术与教学中心。清真寺和学校支撑着当地的知识与宗教生活，城市又靠近撒哈拉商路与河流交通的交汇处。它提醒我们，西非的历史不仅有贸易和政权，也有教育与思想传播。

dateNote.en: Selected fifteenth-to-sixteenth-century scholarly phase; not the city's founding or disappearance. The pin represents the historic urban centre.
dateNote.zh: 选取十五至十六世纪的学术发展阶段，不表示城市的建立或消失。地图标记代表历史城区。

title.zh: 印加帝国：整合安第斯

summary.en: Inca rulers expanded from Cusco through conquest, alliances and kinship ties. Roads, terraces and irrigation systems helped manage varied landscapes and communities. Local traditions continued alongside imperial administration. The Spanish invasion met an empire already strained by succession conflict; conquest changed political control, while Andean peoples and traditions continued.
summary.zh: 印加统治者从库斯科出发，通过征服、联盟和亲属关系扩展统治。道路、梯田与灌溉系统帮助管理不同地形和社群，地方传统与帝国治理并存。西班牙入侵发生时，帝国已受到继承权冲突影响；征服改变了政治控制，但安第斯人民与文化传统继续延续。

dateNote.en: The Met uses 1438–1532 for the expansion-era Inca state. The invasion and subsequent resistance continued later; this endpoint is not the disappearance of Inca descendants.
dateNote.zh: 大都会艺术博物馆将1438至1532年用于扩展时期的印加国家。入侵与后续抵抗延续到更晚，结束年份不表示印加后裔消失。

sources.title: Inka Road History Timeline
sources.publisher: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian

title.en: Himeji: a castle as a system
title.zh: 姬路：作为系统的城堡

summary.en: Himeji’s keeps, walls, gates and connecting buildings formed a coordinated defensive complex. Its timber construction and white plastered surfaces also created a distinctive appearance, combining political display with practical functions. The castle remained the centre of a feudal domain until 1868. Reading its buildings as a system makes it possible to ask how movement, protection, maintenance and the representation of authority were organised within a single landscape.
summary.zh: 姬路城的天守、城墙、城门与连接建筑共同构成防御体系。木结构与白色灰泥表面又形成鲜明外观，把权力展示与实际功能结合起来。这座城堡一直作为藩的中心使用到1868年。把各部分看成一个系统，就能思考通行、防御、维护与权威象征如何在同一片空间中组织。

dateNote.en: Start is a century bound for the surviving early-17th-century complex; 1868 marks the end of its feudal administrative role, not the disappearance of the castle.
dateNote.zh: 起始值表示现存17世纪早期建筑群的世纪边界；1868年指其藩政中心角色结束，不是城堡消失。

sources.title: Himeji-jo
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis describes early-17th-century structures and continuous domain-centre use until 1868.

title.zh: 泰姬陵：建筑与纪念

summary.en: The Mughal emperor Shah Jahan commissioned the Taj Mahal at Agra as a mausoleum for his wife. White marble, a planned garden setting and an ordered architectural composition made remembrance visible in the landscape. This entry focuses on the main construction phase given by UNESCO. Studying the monument invites questions about the relationship between personal memory, imperial resources and the work of the many makers involved in a large building project.
summary.zh: 莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗下令在阿格拉为妻子修建泰姬陵。白色大理石、园林布局与有序的建筑构图，把纪念之情转化为景观。本条目聚焦来源给出的主体营造阶段。观察这座陵墓，也可以思考个人记忆、帝国资源和大型工程中众多建造者的劳动之间有什么联系。

dateNote.en: 1631–1648 follows UNESCO’s stated main building interval; it is not the full Mughal period or every later addition.
dateNote.zh: 1631—1648年采用来源给出的主体建筑区间，并非整个莫卧儿时期或所有后续工程的年代。

sources.title: Taj Mahal
sources.evidenceNote: Description states construction in Agra, 1631–1648, commissioned by Shah Jahan as a mausoleum; synthesis describes the garden composition.

title.zh: 铁桥峡：相互连接的工业景观

summary.en: At Coalbrookdale, iron production using coke developed in 1709. The iron bridge erected nearby in 1779 became a visible demonstration of new construction possibilities. Mines, furnaces, workshops, housing and transport routes show that industrial change depended on connected activities and communities, not on one machine or inventor alone.
summary.zh: 1709年，煤溪谷发展了用焦炭冶铁的生产技术。附近于1779年架起的铁桥展示了新的建造可能。矿井、炉窑、工坊、住宅和运输路线共同说明，工业变化依赖相互连接的活动与社群，而不是单独一台机器或一位发明家。

dateNote.en: Two documented milestones bound this focused interval: coke iron production in 1709 and bridge erection in 1779. Industrial activity continued later.
dateNote.zh: 时间范围以两项有记载的事件为界：1709年的焦炭冶铁和1779年的铁桥架设。此后当地工业活动仍在继续。

title.en: New Zealand: women win the parliamentary vote
title.zh: 新西兰：女性取得国会选举投票权

summary.en: On 19 September 1893, a new Electoral Act gave women the right to vote in New Zealand parliamentary elections. The change followed years of campaigning and large petitions, including those organised by Kate Sheppard and other suffragists. It made New Zealand the first self-governing country to grant that parliamentary voting right to women. The event illustrates how organised participation can change electoral rules; it did not, by itself, complete the wider struggle for political equality.
summary.zh: 1893年9月19日，新的选举法赋予新西兰女性参加国会选举的投票权。此前，凯特·谢泼德等参政权倡导者进行了多年活动，并组织大规模请愿。新西兰由此成为首个赋予女性这一国会投票权的自治国家。这一事件展现了组织参与如何改变选举制度，但不表示更广泛的政治平等已经全部实现。

dateNote.en: Single-year event; law signed 19 September 1893. The marker indicates the legislative centre, not every place where campaigning occurred.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份事件：1893年9月19日签署法律。标记表示立法中心，并非所有运动发生地点。

sources.title: New Zealand women and the vote
sources.publisher: Manatū Taonga — Ministry for Culture and Heritage
sources.evidenceNote: Ministry account gives 19 September 1893, parliamentary voting right, campaigns and petitions.

title.en: San Francisco: signing the UN Charter
title.zh: 旧金山：签署《联合国宪章》

summary.en: Delegates met in San Francisco to prepare the founding Charter of the United Nations. The Charter was signed on 26 June 1945 and entered into force on 24 October that year. Its creation offers a specific place and date for studying an institution with a global reach. The map marker identifies the signing city; the organisation’s later activity and the decisions of its members cannot be reduced to that one location or founding moment.
summary.zh: 代表们在旧金山筹备联合国的创立文件。《联合国宪章》于1945年6月26日签署，同年10月24日生效。这为研究一个全球性机构提供了具体地点与时间。地图标记表示签署城市，而该机构后来的活动以及成员国的决策，不能被缩减为这一地点或创立时刻。

dateNote.en: Single-year event: signature on 26 June and entry into force on 24 October 1945.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份事件：1945年6月26日签署，10月24日生效。

sources.title: Charter of the United Nations: treaty record
sources.evidenceNote: Official treaty record identifies San Francisco, 26 June 1945 and entry into force on 24 October 1945.

sources.title: Charter of the United Nations research guide
sources.evidenceNote: Guide identifies San Francisco conference, 25 April–26 June 1945, as the meeting to draft the Charter.

title.zh: 1947年：独立与印巴分治

location.label: New Delhi; one representative centre of a subcontinental event

summary.en: In August 1947, British rule ended and India and Pakistan became independent states. Independence was accompanied by Partition, population movement and communal violence. The event therefore contains several connected histories: political self-government, the drawing of borders, and the experiences of families forced to move. New Delhi is only a representative marker here. The effects crossed many regions, including places now in India, Pakistan and Bangladesh, and cannot be represented by a single point.
summary.zh: 1947年8月，英国统治结束，印度和巴基斯坦成为独立国家。独立伴随着分治、人口迁移和族群暴力。因此，这一事件同时包含政治自主、边界划分以及被迫离家者的经历。新德里在此只是代表性标记；影响遍及多个地区，包括今天的印度、巴基斯坦和孟加拉国，无法由一个点完整表示。

dateNote.en: Single-year event; independence and Partition in August 1947. No present-day boundary is projected backward as a historical map.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份事件：1947年8月的独立与分治。不把今日边界倒置为当时的历史地图。

sources.title: Independence and Partition, 1947
sources.evidenceNote: Museum account describes independence, August 1947 partition, mass migration, violence and geographically separated Pakistan.

title.zh: 万隆：亚非合作

summary.en: Twenty-nine Asian and African countries took part in the Bandung Conference from 18 to 24 April 1955. The gathering discussed peace, cooperation and freedom from colonialism and imperialism. Its records include documents, photographs and films preserved as the Asian–African Conference Archives. Bandung gives learners a way to examine international history from an Asian and African meeting place, rather than treating world diplomacy as something that happened only in European or North American capitals.
summary.zh: 1955年4月18日至24日，29个亚非国家参加万隆会议，讨论和平、合作以及摆脱殖民主义和帝国主义等议题。会议留下的文件、照片与影片组成亚非会议档案。万隆使我们能够从亚非国家的会场观察国际历史，而不是只围绕欧洲或北美的首都理解世界外交。

dateNote.en: Single-year event; 18–24 April 1955. The countries represented had different political systems and circumstances.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份事件：1955年4月18—24日；与会国家的政治制度和处境并不相同。

sources.title: Asian-African Conference Archives
sources.evidenceNote: UNESCO’s archive description gives conference dates, Bandung, 29 participating countries and stated aims.

title.zh: 加纳：独立与非洲外交

summary.en: Ghana became independent on 6 March 1957. Its new foreign ministry and diplomatic service were part of the institutions needed to conduct relations with other states. Kwame Nkrumah connected foreign policy with a vision of African unity, and an African Affairs Secretariat became one expression of that aim. The entry focuses on independence and institution-building; it should not be used to claim that Ghana was the first independent African country.
summary.zh: 加纳于1957年3月6日独立。新的外交部和外交机构，是开展国家间关系所需制度的一部分。夸梅·恩克鲁玛把外交政策与非洲团结的愿景联系起来，非洲事务秘书处体现了这一方向。本条目聚焦独立与机构建设，并不宣称加纳是非洲第一个独立国家。

dateNote.en: Single-year independence milestone: 6 March 1957; subsequent diplomatic institutions developed over time.
dateNote.zh: 独立里程碑为1957年3月6日；后续外交机构是在不同时间逐步发展的。

sources.title: Brief history of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.evidenceNote: Ministry history gives 6 March 1957 independence, ministry formation, Nkrumah’s African-unity emphasis and the African Affairs Secretariat.

title.en: Apollo 11: from Earth to the Moon
title.zh: 阿波罗11号：从地球到月球

location.label: Kennedy Space Center; Earth launch location

summary.en: Apollo 11 launched from Cape Kennedy on 16 July 1969 with Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin and Michael Collins. Armstrong and Aldrin reached the lunar surface while Collins remained in lunar orbit. The mission combined landing and return objectives with scientific observations, experiments and sample collection. This Earth map places the event at its launch site, not at the landing location on the Moon; it offers a starting point for following a journey beyond the map.
summary.zh: 1969年7月16日，阿波罗11号载着尼尔·阿姆斯特朗、巴兹·奥尔德林和迈克尔·柯林斯从肯尼迪角发射。阿姆斯特朗与奥尔德林到达月面，柯林斯留在绕月轨道。任务把登月和返回地球与观测、实验、样本采集结合起来。这张地球地图标示的是发射地点，而不是月球上的着陆点。

dateNote.en: Single-year mission; launch 16 July, lunar landing 20 July 1969. Coordinates are the Earth launch site.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份任务：1969年7月16日发射，7月20日登月；坐标为地球发射地点。

sources.title: Apollo 11 Mission Overview
sources.evidenceNote: NASA mission account provides crew, launch and landing chronology, lunar orbit roles, experiments and sample objectives.

title.en: CERN: the World Wide Web begins
title.zh: 欧洲核子研究中心：万维网的起点

summary.en: Tim Berners-Lee developed the World Wide Web at CERN in 1989 to support information sharing among researchers. The first website explained the Web project itself. In 1993, CERN released Web software into the public domain and later used an open licence. The sequence connects a research community’s practical need with choices about sharing a technical system. The Web is a particular information system; its invention is not the beginning of the Internet.
summary.zh: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李于1989年在欧洲核子研究中心开发万维网，以满足研究人员共享信息的需要。第一个网站介绍的正是万维网项目。1993年，中心把相关软件置于公共领域，之后又采用开放许可。这段历史把研究社区的实际需求与技术共享方式联系起来。万维网是一种信息系统，它的诞生并不等于互联网的起源。

dateNote.en: Selected development window, 1989–1993: invention to the public-domain release. The Web continued developing afterward.
dateNote.zh: 选取1989—1993年，即诞生至公共领域发布的阶段；此后万维网继续发展。

sources.title: The birth of the Web
sources.evidenceNote: CERN gives invention in 1989, research information-sharing purpose, first website and 30 April 1993 public-domain release.

title.zh: 南非：民主选举

summary.en: South Africa’s 1994 election allowed adults to vote regardless of race, after a history of exclusion under apartheid. The government commemorates 27 April as the central date of the democratic election, and Nelson Mandela was inaugurated on 10 May. The transition changed political representation and opened a new constitutional period. The marker stands for a nationwide event; it does not imply that voting occurred only in Pretoria or that every consequence of apartheid ended in one year.
summary.zh: 1994年南非选举使成年人能够不分种族参加投票，改变了种族隔离制度下的政治排斥。南非政府以4月27日纪念这一民主选举，纳尔逊·曼德拉于5月10日就职。这一转变改变了政治代表制度，并开启新的宪政阶段。标记代表全国性事件，不表示只有比勒陀利亚投票，也不表示种族隔离的所有后果在一年内消失。

dateNote.en: Single-year transition; 27 April 1994 is the commemorated election date, followed by inauguration on 10 May.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份转型：1994年4月27日为纪念的选举日期，5月10日举行总统就职。

sources.title: Milestones of 20 Years of Freedom
sources.evidenceNote: Government chronology records 27 April election, adult voting regardless of race and 10 May inauguration.
